env.name: OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN
env.purpose: operator auth token; presence only is reported

env.name: OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_WS
env.purpose: target gateway websocket URL; defaults to local gateway

env.name: OPENCLAW_SESSION_KEY
env.purpose: target session key or coarse session class

env.name: OPENCLAW_SEAT_NAME
env.purpose: public seat identifier used in proof artifacts

env.name: OPENCLAW_SEAT_CLASS
env.purpose: seat behavior class used by token/bracket rows

env.name: OPENCLAW_ROW_MANIFEST
env.purpose: manifest path for a specific row run

env.name: OPENCLAW_SELECTED_ROWS
env.purpose: comma-separated selected row ids whose continuation depth is validated before dispatch

env.name: OPENCLAW_EXPECTED_MAX_SPAWN_DEPTH
env.purpose: optional exact isolated proof-profile maxSpawnDepth expectation

env.name: OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_RESTART_CMD
env.purpose: optional self-contained restart command for config-mutating proof fixtures; default is documented as openclaw gateway restart --safe --wait 10s

env.name: OPENCLAW_K6_COST_CAP_TEST_VALUE
env.purpose: optional low costCapTokens value for cost-cap boundary rows; default must be row-local and restored

concurrency.reason: read-only seat readiness preflight; no continuation/delegate/compaction calls are fired

redaction.guarantee: Report env values as booleans only; never print token/secret values, prompt bodies, session keys beyond coarse scope, or raw gateway payloads.
